admissions.label: Admissions
admissions.description: Total new patient admissions (Start of Care) within the reporting period.
admissions.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) WHERE epi.epi_SocDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

admissions_by_care_type.label: Admissions by Care Type
admissions_by_care_type.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) GROUP BY ct.ct_name WHERE epi.epi_SocDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

current_census.label: Current Census
current_census.description: Active patient count as of a given date — patients on service with no discharge.
current_census.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) WHERE epi.epi_SocDate <= @AsOfDate AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate)

average_daily_census.label: Average Daily Census
average_daily_census.description: Average number of active patients per day over the reporting window.

current_census_by_service_line_branch.label: Current Census by Service Line and Branch
current_census_by_service_line_branch.description: Active patient count cross-tabulated by service line and branch.
current_census_by_service_line_branch.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) GROUP BY epi.epi_slid, epi.epi_branchcode WHERE epi.epi_SocDate <= @AsOfDate AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate)

average_daily_census_by_service_line_bra.label: Average Daily Census by Service Line and Branch
average_daily_census_by_service_line_bra.description: ADC calculated at the intersection of service line and branch.

daily_census.label: Daily Census
daily_census.description: Active patient count for each individual calendar date in the reporting window.
daily_census.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate <= @AsOfDate AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate) THEN epi.epi_id END)

daily_census_trend.label: Daily Census Trend
daily_census_trend.description: Time-series of daily census values showing patient volume trend over the window.
daily_census_trend.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) per calendar_date GROUP BY census_date

patient_days.label: Patient Days
patient_days.description: Total patient-days accumulated across all active episodes within the reporting window.

ntuc.label: NTUC
ntuc.description: Non-Transferred Unduplicated Census — unique patients currently on service, de-duplicated across branches.
ntuc.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_PatientID) WHERE epi.epi_SocDate <= @AsOfDate AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate)

hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.label: Hospice Census Equivalent By Branch
hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.description: Branch-level HCE — Hospice patient-days weighted by HCE_FACTOR.
hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.formula: SUM(patient_days_in_window * @HCE_FACTOR) WHERE epi_slid = 2 GROUP BY epi_branchcode

hh_palliative_combined_hce.label: HH and Palliative Combined HCE
hh_palliative_combined_hce.description: Combined HCE for Home Health and Palliative service lines using 0.40 weight.
hh_palliative_combined_hce.formula: SUM(patient_days_in_window * 0.40) WHERE epi_slid IN (1, 25001) GROUP BY epi_branchcode

enterprise_total_hce.label: Enterprise Total HCE
enterprise_total_hce.description: Enterprise-wide HCE — Hospice at 1.00 weight, HH/Palliative at 0.40 weight.
enterprise_total_hce.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN epi_slid=2 THEN patient_days*1.00 ELSE patient_days*0.40 END)

implied_average_daily_census.label: Implied Average Daily Census
implied_average_daily_census.description: Patient Days divided by the ADC window — normalised census proxy.

avg_days_referral_to_admission.label: Average Days Referral to Admission
avg_days_referral_to_admission.description: Mean elapsed days from referral receipt to Start of Care.

admissions_within_2_days.label: Admissions Within 2 Days
admissions_within_2_days.description: Count of admissions where SOC occurred within 2 calendar days of referral.
admissions_within_2_days.formula: COUNT(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, epi_ReferralDate, epi_SocDate) <= 2 THEN 1 END)

referral_conversion_rate.label: Referral Conversion Rate
referral_conversion_rate.description: Percentage of received referrals that converted to an admission.

referrals_received.label: Referrals Received
referrals_received.description: Total referrals received within the reporting period regardless of outcome.
referrals_received.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) WHERE epi.epi_ReferralDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

visit_notes_activity.label: Visit Notes Activity
visit_notes_activity.description: Total visit notes entered within the reporting period.
visit_notes_activity.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT vn.vn_id) WHERE vn.vn_visit_date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

recertifications.label: Recertifications
recertifications.description: Episodes that were recertified within the reporting period.
recertifications.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) WHERE epi.epi_RecertDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

face_to_face_compliance.label: Face To Face Compliance
face_to_face_compliance.description: Percentage of applicable episodes with a compliant Face-to-Face encounter on file.
face_to_face_compliance.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN epi.epi_F2FCompliant = 1 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(epi.epi_id), 0) * 100

noe_compliance.label: NOE Compliance
noe_compliance.description: Percentage of hospice elections with a compliant Notice of Election filed on time.
noe_compliance.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN epi.epi_NOECompliant = 1 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(epi.epi_id), 0) * 100

certification_compliance.label: Certification Compliance
certification_compliance.description: Percentage of plans of care with physician certification completed on time.
certification_compliance.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN epi.epi_CertCompliant = 1 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(epi.epi_id), 0) * 100

visit_note_documentation_compliance.label: Visit Note Documentation Compliance
visit_note_documentation_compliance.description: Percentage of visit notes signed within 24 hours of the visit.
visit_note_documentation_compliance.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN vn_completed_flag=1 AND DATEDIFF(hour, vn_visit_date, vn_signed_datetime) <= 24 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(vn_id), 0) * 100

qa_compliance_rate.label: QA Compliance Rate
qa_compliance_rate.description: Percentage of QA-reviewed items that passed review within the period.
qa_compliance_rate.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN qa_status = 'PASS' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(qa_review_id), 0) * 100

qa_items_reviewed.label: QA Items Reviewed
qa_items_reviewed.description: Total number of QA review items completed in the period.
qa_items_reviewed.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT qa_review_id) WHERE qa_review_date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

qa_items_failed.label: QA Items Failed
qa_items_failed.description: Count of QA review items that did not pass review.

qa_corrective_actions.label: QA Corrective Actions
qa_corrective_actions.description: Number of corrective action plans generated from failed QA reviews.
qa_corrective_actions.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT corrective_action_id) WHERE ca_issued_date BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.label: BP1 Compliance Within 48 Hours
bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.description: Percentage of PDGM periods where the first billable visit was completed within 48 hours.
bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN bp1_completed_flag=1 AND DATEDIFF(hour, period_start_date, bp1_completed_datetime) <= 48 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(period_id), 0) * 100

bp1_compliance_status.label: BP1 Compliance Status
bp1_compliance_status.description: PASS / FAIL classification based on whether BP1 compliance rate meets the 80% target.
bp1_compliance_status.formula: CASE WHEN bp1_compliance_pct >= 80 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END

plan_of_care_compliance.label: Plan of Care Compliance
plan_of_care_compliance.description: Percentage of active episodes with a current, physician-signed Plan of Care on file.
plan_of_care_compliance.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN epi.epi_PocCompliant = 1 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(epi.epi_id), 0) * 100

qa_total_reviews.label: QA Total Reviews
qa_total_reviews.description: Total QA review items in all statuses (Pending, Pass, Fail, Overdue).

qa_pass_rate.label: QA Pass Rate
qa_pass_rate.description: Percentage of total QA reviews that resulted in a pass outcome.
qa_pass_rate.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN qa_status = 'PASS' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(qa_review_id), 0) * 100

qa_fail_rate.label: QA Fail Rate
qa_fail_rate.description: Percentage of QA reviews resulting in failure.
qa_fail_rate.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN qa_status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(qa_review_id), 0) * 100

qa_pending_reviews.label: QA Pending Reviews
qa_pending_reviews.description: Count of QA items awaiting review as of the report date.

qa_overdue_reviews.label: QA Overdue Reviews
qa_overdue_reviews.description: QA review items that have exceeded their SLA completion deadline.
qa_overdue_reviews.formula: COUNT(CASE WHEN qa_status = 'PENDING' AND DATEDIFF(day, qa_due_date, GETDATE()) > 0 THEN 1 END)

total_discharges.label: Total Discharges
total_discharges.description: All discharges within the period across all classification types.
total_discharges.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id) WHERE epi.epi_DischargeDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

live_discharge_rate.label: Live Discharge Rate
live_discharge_rate.description: Percentage of discharges that are live (non-death) classifications.
live_discharge_rate.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN dc_class IN ('LiveDC-PatientInitiated','LiveDC-HospiceInitiated') THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(epi.epi_id), 0) * 100

avg_length_of_stay.label: Average Length of Stay
avg_length_of_stay.description: Mean episode length in days from SOC to discharge or current date.
avg_length_of_stay.formula: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, epi_SocDate, ISNULL(epi_DischargeDate, GETDATE())) AS FLOAT))

median_length_of_stay.label: Median Length of Stay
median_length_of_stay.description: Median episode length in days by branch.
median_length_of_stay.formula: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(day, epi_SocDate, ISNULL(epi_DischargeDate, GETDATE()))) OVER (PARTITION BY epi_branchcode)

current_active_length_of_stay.label: Current Active Length of Stay
current_active_length_of_stay.description: Average days since SOC for currently active (undischarged) patients.
current_active_length_of_stay.formula: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, epi_SocDate, @AsOfDate) AS FLOAT)) WHERE epi_DischargeDate IS NULL

discharge_classification_mix.label: Discharge Classification Mix
discharge_classification_mix.description: Distribution of discharges across classification groups (Death, LiveDC-PatientInitiated, LiveDC-HospiceInitiated, Other).

lupa_rate.label: LUPA Rate
lupa_rate.description: Percentage of PDGM 30-day periods classified as Low Utilization Payment Adjustment.
lupa_rate.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN lupa_indicator IN ('LUPA','L') THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(period_id), 0) * 100

calculated_lupa_exposure.label: Calculated LUPA Exposure
calculated_lupa_exposure.description: Total revenue at risk from LUPA classifications — full payment minus reduced LUPA payment.
calculated_lupa_exposure.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN lupa_indicator IN ('LUPA','L') THEN expected_payment - lupa_payment ELSE 0 END)

billing_holds.label: Billing Holds
billing_holds.description: Count of billing line items currently in hold status pending resolution.
billing_holds.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN li_hold_flag = 1 THEN li_id END)

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.description: Total billed revenue from submitted and paid billing line items.

revenue_per_patient_day.label: Revenue Per Patient Day
revenue_per_patient_day.description: Total revenue divided by total patient days — revenue efficiency metric.

billing_hold_sla_compliance.label: Billing Hold SLA Compliance
billing_hold_sla_compliance.description: Percentage of billing holds resolved within the 5-day SLA target.
billing_hold_sla_compliance.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN li_hold_flag=1 AND li_hold_days <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN li_hold_flag=1 THEN 1 END), 0) * 100

accounts_receivable_aging.label: Accounts Receivable Aging
accounts_receivable_aging.description: AR balance distributed across aging buckets: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, Over 90 days.
accounts_receivable_aging.formula: SUM(li_amount) GROUP BY ar_aging_bucket WHERE li_claim_status NOT IN ('Paid', 'Denied')

ar_over_90_days.label: AR Over 90 Days
ar_over_90_days.description: Total outstanding AR balance where the service date is more than 90 days ago.
ar_over_90_days.formula: SUM(li_amount) WHERE DATEDIFF(day, li_service_date, @AsOfDate) > 90 AND li_claim_status NOT IN ('Paid', 'Denied')

unbilled_revenue.label: Unbilled Revenue
unbilled_revenue.description: Revenue on completed visits that has not yet been billed or submitted.

ar_total.label: AR Total
ar_total.description: Total outstanding accounts receivable balance across all aging buckets.

ar_collection_rate.label: AR Collection Rate
ar_collection_rate.description: Percentage of billed revenue successfully collected within the period.
ar_collection_rate.formula: CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN li_claim_status = 'Paid' THEN li_amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN li_claim_status IN ('Submitted','Paid') THEN li_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100

worker_productivity_achievement.label: Worker Productivity Achievement
worker_productivity_achievement.description: Percentage of workers meeting or exceeding their productivity target for the period.
worker_productivity_achievement.formula: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN earned_points >= target_points THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(worker_id), 0) * 100

worker_productivity_points.label: Worker Productivity Points
worker_productivity_points.description: Aggregated earned, expected, and target productivity points by worker and branch.
worker_productivity_points.formula: SUM(earned_points), SUM(expected_points), SUM(target_points) GROUP BY worker_id, epi_branchcode

worker_productivity_detail.label: Worker Productivity Detail
worker_productivity_detail.description: Row-level productivity detail per worker — earned, expected, target, achievement status.
worker_productivity_detail.formula: SELECT worker_id, earned_points, expected_points, target_points, CASE WHEN earned_points >= target_points THEN 'Met' ELSE 'Not Met' END AS achievement_status FROM WORKER_BASE JOIN productivity_summary
